import json
d=json.load(open('.ai/task/batch-3aff0de9eab35d51661b-contextual-000/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-final-full.json'))
p=d['payload']
for i,c in enumerate(p['bounded_context']):
    txt=c['context']
    head,_,rest=txt.partition('source_facts_v1:')
    f=json.loads(rest)
    print('###',i,head.strip())
    for a in f['fact'].get('anchors',[]):
        print('  anchor',a.get('repository'),a.get('public_source_path'),a.get('kind'),a.get('matching_lines'))
    print('  other fact keys:',[k for k in f['fact'] if k!='anchors'])
"
